sources.name: Connected Nations FAQs
facts: Fixed broadband coverage, fixed broadband performance and mobile coverage are separate downloads
Speed information is available only in fixed broadband products
Since July 2024 Ofcom's revised collection can include more providers but may reduce specific information from each
sources.access_guard: Postcode performance files are not assumed where Ofcom states the data is robust only to local-authority level.
sources.limitation: Published availability or aggregate performance does not prove an active service, installation or live retail order for an individual parcel.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom page; Ofcom data terms apply

Data collected for the report was used to update Ofcom coverage checkers

sources.name: ONS Postcode Directory and National Statistics Postcode Lookup
sources.published_or_updated: Official product guidance verified 31 July 2026; quarterly release cycle
facts: ONSPD links current and terminated postcodes to administrative and other geographies
Postcodes are allocated using a point-in-polygon method based on a postcode grid reference
Products are released quarterly in February, May, August and November
sources.access_guard: Postcode epoch and termination status must be retained during joins.
sources.limitation: A postcode mean grid reference can allocate addresses on the other side of a boundary and is not an exact parcel or address point.
sources.access_and_licence: Official ONS Open Geography product; stated licensing applies

sources.name: ONS Postal geographies
facts: A small-user postcode may contain up to 100 addresses and typically contains about 15
Postcode boundaries often do not align with administrative boundaries
Postcodes can be recoded and may be reused in a different place after two years
sources.access_guard: Current/terminated state and source epoch are mandatory; a postcode string alone is not a durable property identifier.
sources.limitation: A unit postcode is a delivery geography shared by multiple addresses, not a unique parcel key.

sources.name: ONS postcode-to-local-authority quality and correction notice
facts: The cited August 2023 file had 10,799 postcodes that could not be assigned to a local authority because no grid reference was available
About 15,000 postcodes contained addresses straddling local-authority boundaries
A correction replaced an incomplete download that originally contained only postcode areas A to H
sources.access_guard: File completeness, postcode-area coverage and null-grid-reference counts must be checked before using a lookup.
sources.limitation: These figures document quality risks for a historical release and are not current parcel-level broadband evidence.
sources.access_and_licence: Official ONS publication and associated downloads

sources.name: Code-Point Open
sources.published_or_updated: Current product page verified 31 July 2026; quarterly updates
facts: Open dataset covers approximately 1.7 million current postcode units in Great Britain
Updated every three months
Available as CSV and GeoPackage
sources.access_guard: Use only as a current postcode point with source epoch; do not expand a point into a parcel polygon.
sources.limitation: A postcode point represents a postcode unit and can cover many addresses; it is not a UPRN, building, title or serviceability record.
sources.access_and_licence: Free OS OpenData product; licence and attribution apply

sources.name: OS OpenMap Local building feature
facts: A building feature is a built entity that includes a roof
The polygon is explicitly described as a generalised building
A feature may be an amalgamation of other buildings and structures
sources.access_guard: Generalised building geometry is restricted to visual/context QA and cannot become canonical parcel geometry.
sources.limitation: A generalised building can contain multiple addresses, UPRNs, postcodes or titles and cannot prove their equivalence.

sources.name: OS Open UPRN
sources.published_or_updated: Current product page verified 31 July 2026; six-week updates
facts: Provides a UPRN and coordinate for every addressable location in Great Britain
Approximately 40 million addressable locations are represented
Coverage includes residential, commercial and non-postal features
sources.access_guard: Non-postal classifications and point-to-polygon ambiguity must be handled before any parcel binding.
sources.limitation: An addressable-location coordinate is not a title boundary and does not establish broadband availability or retail orderability.
sources.access_and_licence: Free OS OpenData product; licence and attribution apply
